arStrings.szText: Gain {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} additional pillars. In addition, {c_important}Landslide's{/c} size is increased by {c_number}[SF_29 * 100]%{/c} and damage is increased to {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DAMAGE}{/c}.

{c_important}Landslide's{/c} pillars automatically crush individual targets in the area.

{c_important}Landslide{/c} gains a {c_number}[SF_31 * 100]%{/c} damage bonus for the first pillar, reducing by {c_number}[SF_32 * 100]%{/c} for each subsequent pillar.

When cast, {c_important}Landslide{/c} is dormant at the target location for {c_number}[SF_24]{/c} second. Afterwards, {c_important}Landslide{/c} will automatically trigger when an enemy steps on it, dealing {c_number}[SF_23 * 100]%{/c} bonus damage split between all enemies damaged.

Max {c_number}[SF_25]{/c} {c_important}Landslides{/c} can be active at a time and last {c_number}[SF_26]{/c} seconds. {c_important}Landslide{/c} is also a {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill.
{c_important}Landslide{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_39 * 100]%{/c} bonus damage when hitting the first enemy.

{c_important}Landslide's{/c} Critical Strike Chance is increased by {c_number}[SF_41 * 100]%{/c} and up to an additional {c_number}[SF_43*100]%{/c} based on how much of your Maximum Life is {c_important}{u}Fortified{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Landslide{/c} grants {c_number}[SF_44]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} when hitting the first enemy.
